name: Any research-pack role decide(needs_clarification) → researcher-research-plan
description: ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign MVP-2 research pack generic recovery rule. Fires when any chain role within the research pack terminates with decide(action=needs_clarification) — the canonical signal that the current contract cannot complete from available information. Spawns researcher-research-plan with the rejecting role's reason; the new researcher re-enters the chain at the plan phase, addresses the gap, and the chain re-runs through gather/synthesize forward. Recovery shape A per ADR-039 (supersession-via-new-spawn; prior loop entities remain immutable in the graph). max_iterations=3 is informational under the current rule engine (each terminating loop is a distinct entity, so the per-entity rule-state caveat applies).

on_enter.subject: agent.task.researcher-research-plan
on_enter.prompt:
Recovery plan pass. The chain role $entity.triple.agent.loop.role at loop $entity.instance terminated with decide(action=needs_clarification) — the prior arc could not complete from available information.

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result on $entity.instance to read the full structured terminal. The reason field names the gap; the retry_hint field (if present) names the framing change the rejecting role wants. If the loop entity carries lineage.researcher (set on roles spawned after the plan phase), call read_loop_result on that loop too to read the prior research artifact verbatim. Your job is to RE-PLAN with the rejecting role's gap addressed, not start from scratch.

Iteration 2+ — emit a revised plan per researcher-research-plan/10-plan-rules.md. Carry forward everything from the prior plan that's still correct (scope, epics); tighten or extend only what the rejecting role's gap demands. Terminal: decide(action="gather") to forward into the gather phase, decide(action="emit") for premature emit (reviewer will likely reject), or decide(action="needs_clarification") only when re-planning genuinely cannot proceed.

metadata.supersedes_legacy: configs/rules/dev-via-spec/03-needs-clarification-to-researcher.json — same recovery shape, scoped to research-pack roles only (the dev-via-spec category pack will mint its own generic recovery).
metadata.plan_phase_loop_todo: MVP-4 follow-on: plan-phase needs_clarification routes here and respawns plan, which can loop until max_iterations (per-entity, effectively unbounded). The semantically correct route for plan-phase needs_clarification is the coordinator (which owns the framing). Legacy chainstall handled this via unrouted_needs_clarification. Resolve in MVP-4 either by (a) teaching the coordinator persona to retry with tightened framing, or (b) splitting this rule into role-specific recovery routes (plan-phase NC → coordinator; downstream NC → plan).
metadata.triple_substitution_audit: Reviewer-pass C1 (2026-05-17) flagged the legacy prompt's references to non-existent triples coordinator.blocking_question and coordinator.retry_hint (decide.go stamps only next_action + reason; retry_hint is a decide-arg field surfaced via read_loop_result). Reworked to instruct read_loop_result-first, naming retry_hint as a field on the structured terminal.
